serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Annalie.face.normal
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: Hi, Annalie! How are you?
Lady Annalie: I’m fine. Glad to see two managed to come.
You: We said we would, so here we are.
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.angry
Bot: I hope that awful Britannia person didn’t harass you any further after we left! 
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
Lady Annalie: Don’t worry, she’s harmless. All yap no bite. Typical loudmouth b-
You: Come on, Annalie. I wouldn’t want {f_botName} to repeat those words after you.
Lady Annalie: Geez, talk about being overprotective.
Lady Annalie: Anyway, leave that person to me to deal with, you two just enjoy the show.
Bot: So what are we gonna do today? 
Lady Annalie: I know more or less what I’m gonna present during the fashion show. Today we take the measurements and brainstorm some finishing touches.
You: Sounds good to me. Does that mean I can leave you two here and do other stuff?
#Annalie.face.eyeClosed
Lady Annalie: Of course not!
Damn…
#Annalie.face.normal
Lady Annalie: We need at least a few sets of eyes to decide the final designs. I don’t have many helpers so unfortunately you will have to do.
Lady Annalie: Weird, my friend, the second model should already be here. I will text her later.
Lady Annalie: Anyway, without further ado, let’s start!
